title: Kuwahara
description: An edge-preserving painterly filter run as a GPU shader. Each pixel takes the mean of the least-varying of four surrounding sectors, so flat areas melt into brush-like patches while edges stay crisp. Adjustable brush radius, sector sharpness and saturation; brush radius is audio-mappable. Works on the camera, a dropped clip, the demo, or the layers below in the Mixer/Patch.
